versions.content: Service Name Lin Trcv_ Set Op Mode Syntax Std_ Return Type Lin Trcv_ Set Op Mode ( uint8 Lin Network, Lin Trcv_ Trcv Mode Type Op Mode ) Service ID [hex] 0x01 Sync/ Async Synchronous Reentrancy Non Reentrant Parameters (in) Lin Network LIN network to wich API call has to be applied Op Mode The parameter says to which operation mode the change shall be performed. Parameters (inout) None Parameters (out) None Return value Std _ - Return Type E_ OK: will be returned if the transceiver state has been changed to the requested mode. E_ NOT_ OK: will be returned if the transceiver state change is not accepted or has failed or the parameter is out of the allowed range. Description The internal state of the LIN transceiver driver is switched to mode given in the parameter Op Mode. Available via Lin Trcv.h
